# Wayd

> An intelligent delivery management platform designed to give engineering leaders and teams end-to-end visibility into software delivery.

## Overview

When delivery spans multiple teams, projects, and systems, visibility breaks down. Wayd brings it all together — tracking work items, aligning teams to planning intervals and products, and surfacing dependencies across the organization. It acts as a unified hub that synchronizes data from multiple business systems and combines it with capabilities those systems lack.

Wayd supports:

- **Organizations** — Teams and teams of teams with operating models, memberships, hierarchy, and (behind a feature flag) allocations, time away and team capacity
- **Planning** — Planning intervals (PIs), objectives, risks, roadmaps, planning poker, and story maps
- **Work Management** — Workspaces, work items, sprints, work processes, workflows, and work types, synchronized from Azure DevOps; sprint metrics, reports, and delivery forecasting
- **Project Portfolio Management** — Portfolios, programs, projects with lifecycles/stages/tasks, portfolio ranking, priority scoring, strategic initiatives with KPIs
- **Demand Management** — Intake requests, intake desks and channels: asks for delivery capacity before they become projects or work items (in development)
- **Strategic Management** — Visions, strategies, and strategic themes for organizational alignment
- **Product Management** — Product catalog, product dependencies, versions, releases, release packages, deployments, and delivery metrics

- [Cycle Time Report](docs/user-guide/work-management/cycle-time-report.mdx): Cycle time analysis for team-owned and employee-assigned work items
- [Backlog Health Report](docs/user-guide/work-management/backlog-health-report.mdx): Grading a team's backlog for runway, flow, staleness, readiness, and ordering problems
- [Work Distribution Report](docs/user-guide/work-management/work-distribution-report.mdx): Where a team's completed work went, by portfolio, program, project, strategic theme, or work type

- [Projects](docs/user-guide/ppm/projects.mdx): Project lifecycle, status reverts, priority scoring, health checks, stages, tasks, dependencies, plan
- [Scoring Models](docs/user-guide/settings/scoring-models.mdx): Formula-driven criteria, rating scales, outputs, and PPM scoring usage
- [Strategic Initiatives](docs/user-guide/ppm/strategic-initiatives.mdx): Initiatives, KPIs, checkpoints, measurements
- [Projects Dashboard](docs/user-guide/ppm/my-projects.mdx): Triage projects by person, portfolio, or program — health, overdue tasks, stages, and end dates
